field_meaning.hi: पूरी तरह से सॉफ्ट रोबोटिक्स पर आधारित एक रोबोट।

review_objections: Alibaba: The description 'पूरी तरह से सॉफ्ट रोबोटिक्स पर आधारित एक रोबोट' (a robot based entirely on soft robotics) is inaccurate. The Octobot is a soft robot, but it is not 'based on soft robotics' as a general category; it is a specific instance. More importantly, the term 'Octobot' is not a standard, well-known generic term in the field like 'Soft Robot' or 'Snake Robot'; it refers to a specific research prototype (from EPFL). It is doubtful if it qualifies as a standard dictionary entry term compared to others.
